PIPE inference for ncvreg selectors (experimental)

infer_pipe.Rd

Pointwise inference for penalized estimators (PIPE), via ncvreg::intervals(). Gives an estimate, interval and p-value for every candidate term, selected or not, so there is no nonselection option. Currently only available for select_ncvreg() selectors.

Usage

infer_pipe(object, data, conf.level = 0.95, ...)

Arguments

object

a selector from select_ncvreg()

data

the data used to fit the selector

conf.level

.95 by default

...

arguments passed to ncvreg::intervals()

Value

an inferrer object; see tidy.inferrer()
